findings.summary: D2 does not actually aggregate every pre-flight violation: mandatory-route validation is executed only when both report_rel and prompt_rel are valid. If either artifact path escapes while phase-one/keyring/provenance is also invalid, the checker reports only the artifact-path violations and never validates or includes the route violation, requiring another run. This contradicts the stated one-pass aggregation for report/prompt/phase-one/keyring/provenance.
